name: ScrollToll : Screen-Time Gym
description:
Scroll Toll – Earn Your Screen Time With Exercise 
Scroll Toll helps you build healthier phone habits by turning screen time into workout time. Instead of endlessly scrolling through social media, you earn your app usage by completing real exercises — pushups, squats, and overhead reaches — detected in real-time through your phone's camera using pose detection.
HOW IT WORKS

Choose which apps to lock (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and more)
When your screen time runs out, the app blocks access to those apps
Complete exercises in front of your camera to earn more screen time
Each rep earns you minutes — the more you move, the more you scroll

FEATURES

AI-Powered Exercise Detection: Uses your phone's camera and on-device pose estimation to count pushups, squats, and overhead reaches in real-time. All processing happens locally on your device — no video is recorded, stored, or sent anywhere.
App Blocking: Select any apps you want to manage. When your earned screen time runs out, those apps are blocked until you exercise again. You can bank up to 2 hours of screen time.
Smart Usage Tracking: See your daily screen time breakdown with a clear dashboard showing your top 5 most-used apps and how much time you spend on each.
Personalized Onboarding: Take a quick quiz to understand your phone habits, set your screen time goals, and get a personalized plan based on your usage patterns.

Every month we host a live session with a smoking-cessation expert. In these sessions, the psychologist explains the best way to quit smoking and answers attendees’ questions live. These sessions are a unique opportunity to get personalized advice and resolve doubts in real time.

If you choose to phase in while losing weight, you'll start by maintaining your current weight. Over the phase in period, your calorie goal will gradually decrease to your target rate of weight loss.

Track your calories by scanning barcodes, searching our 3.8 million item food database or using the Quick Track tool.
